relations.subject: KOWALEWSKI, Józef Szczepan
relations.evidence: From 1818 studied classical philology and literature at Vilnius University (kand. 1821)

relations.subject: KOWALEWSKI, Józef Szczepan
relations.evidence: In time he became Professor of Mongolian philology at Kazan (1833 Adjunkt, 1834 eo. and 1837 ord., until 1860).

relations.subject: KOWALEWSKI, Józef Szczepan
relations.evidence: returned to Poland in 1863, became Professor of history at Warsaw College (which became university in 1869)

relations.subject: V. F. Vasil’ev
relations.evidence: Among his students at Kazan was V. F. Vasil’ev.
